solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Player taken off before victory against Germany

indicators.note: before places the departing word ahead of the word for victory
against means up against, set right next to the preceding pieces

parts.note: something taken off has left, departed
a victory is a win

explanation.surface: A footballer substituted just before his team beats Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: A winger who plays on the left flank is a player in football or hockey positioned wide on that side.

clue.text: Letter from Greek celebrity raised issue

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the pieces are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet
a celebrity is a big name

explanation.surface: A famous Greek's letter has raised a contentious issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns ETA + NAME (ETANAME) backwards in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue as a verb means to come forth or flow out from a source, a synonym.

clue.text: Engineers puncturing little part of tyre

indicators.note: puncturing means the engineers' letters pierce into the word for little

parts.note: a tad is a little bit
RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army corps

explanation.surface: Army engineers have punctured a small part of a tyre.
explanation.definitionFit: The patterned rubber surface of a tyre that grips the road is called its tread.

clue.text: Supreme folkloric spirit of the skies with no leader

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous sprite of folklore

indicators.note: with no leader means the first letter of the sky word is dropped

parts.note: aerial means of the air or skies

explanation.surface: A supreme sprite of folk tales ruling the heavens, though lacking a chief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no leader' cuts the A from AERIAL, leaving ERIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperial means of an empire or emperor, hence sovereign and supreme in authority.

clue.text: Girl chose to bake mixed vegetables

indicators.note: mixed means the letters of the girl's baking plan are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl decided to bake a mixture of vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: Globe artichokes are thistle-like plants whose edible flower heads are eaten as vegetables.

clue.text: Fish restricted by bloody wound

definitions.note: wound here is the past tense of wind, as of a line

indicators.note: restricted by means the fish is hemmed in by the colour word around it

parts.note: something bloody is red
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: A fish caught and held in by a bloody injury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wound' looks like an injury noun, but it is the past tense of wind, as in winding in a line.
explanation.definitionFit: To have wound a line onto a spool is to have reeled it in, a synonym.

clue.text: Start avoiding university money owed

indicators.note: avoiding means the university letter is left out of the start word

parts.note: a debut is a first appearance, a start

explanation.surface: Starting adult life without going to university, yet still in the red.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt is a sum one is obliged to repay, an exact synonym.

clue.text: Select dress, oddly, that is invaded by insect

indicators.note: oddly means take the first, third and fifth letters of dress
invaded by means the insect goes inside the abbreviation

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, that is
a gnat is a small insect

explanation.surface: Choosing a dress that is oddly swarming with insects.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dress' looks like part of the definition, but 'oddly' takes its odd-placed letters; 'invaded by' signals the insect going inside the abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: To designate someone is to choose or appoint them for a role, a synonym of select.

clue.text: Prosper as gang from the south admits defeat

indicators.note: admits means the defeat word is let inside the other
in a down clue, from the south means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: a mob is a gang
a defeat is a loss

explanation.surface: A gang from the south thrives while admitting a defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the south' turns MOB to BOM, which 'admits' LOSS.
explanation.definitionFit: To blossom is to flourish or develop well, a figurative synonym of prosper.

clue.text: Empty pub close to collapse

parts.note: a bar is a pub

indicators.note: close to means the end letter of collapse is used

explanation.surface: An empty pub on the verge of going under.
explanation.definitionFit: A bare room or cupboard is one that is empty, without contents.

clue.text: Calling for loud noises to disperse

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
f, forte, is the musical marking for loud

indicators.note: to disperse means the letters of noises are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: An appeal for loud noises to be broken up.
explanation.definitionFit: A calling is one's vocation or trade, a synonym for profession.

clue.text: Look good with Cockney woman

parts.note: and means with, together with
a Cockney, a working-class Londoner, drops the h of her, giving 'er

explanation.surface: A Londoner's woman looking good.
explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney is a working-class East Londoner, whose speech famously drops initial H.
explanation.definitionFit: Have a gander is British slang for take a look, so the noun is a glance.

clue.text: Motivate men heading off before capturing US soldiers

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter of men is removed

parts.note: taken as written before its first letter goes

indicators.note: capturing means the old word for before holds the soldiers inside

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
GIs are American soldiers

explanation.surface: Rousing troops: leading men off before capturing American soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' drops the first letter of men; ERE is an old poetic word for before, and GIs are US soldiers, which 'capturing' places within it.
explanation.definitionFit: To energise people is to fill them with drive, which is what it means to motivate them.

clue.text: Urbane director receives an honour when retired

indicators.note: receives means the director abbreviation takes the other letters inside
when retired means the pieces go back, read in reverse

parts.note: the OBE, Officer of the Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: A suave film director is given an honour on retiring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when retired' turns AN + OBE into EBONA, which DIR 'receives'.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair describes a man who is suave, charming and sophisticated, a synonym of urbane.

clue.text: Too eager a shot very botched

indicators.note: botched means the letters of the shot phrase are bungled into a new order

explanation.surface: An impatient shot, taken too keenly, goes badly wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Overhasty means acting too quickly, from excessive eagerness or impatience.

clue.text: Host involved in popular mystery

indicators.note: involved in means the letters sit inside the words popular mystery

explanation.surface: A host taking part in a well-loved whodunnit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Host' looks like a party host, but it means a great multitude.
explanation.definitionFit: A host can be a large gathering or multitude, especially of soldiers, hence a military force.

clue.text: Swimmer from south-east region acquiring bye (male)

indicators.note: acquiring means the region word takes in the bye letter

parts.note: an area is a region
B abbreviates bye in cricket scoring

explanation.surface: A fish from a south-eastern area gets a bye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'acquiring' puts B into AREA, giving ABREA.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea bream are fish, and a fish is a swimmer in crossword-style definition by example.

clue.text: Cultural feature this writer duplicated

indicators.note: duplicated means the pronoun is written out twice

parts.note: this writer means the setter, who refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: A cultural trait the writer has copied.
explanation.definitionFit: A meme is an idea or behaviour passed from person to person within a culture.

clue.text: Inform journalist you heard about alien uprising

parts.note: ED is an editor, a journalist

indicators.note: heard means the word is taken by how it is said

parts.note: the word you, spoken, is the letter U
ca, circa, means about

indicators.note: in a down clue, uprising means the alien is read upwards

parts.note: ET is the film alien, the extra-terrestrial

explanation.surface: A reporter tells you about an alien uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: To educate someone is to teach them, which shades into informing or instructing them.

clue.text: I caught bird around small calves, perhaps

definitions.note: plural noun, examples of things that break off glaciers

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: around means the bird is turned about

parts.note: a grebe is a diving water bird

explanation.surface: Catching a bird among small calves on the farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'calves' looks like young cattle, but a glacier calves when ice breaks off it; 'around' turns the bird backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Icebergs are what a glacier's edge produces when it calves, so they are the calves of ice sheets.

clue.text: Turned up extract from Phoebe: Lunar Goddess — fine piece

indicators.note: Turned up says the hidden letters are read backwards
extract from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An excerpt about Phoebe, goddess of the moon.
explanation.definitionFit: A granule is a tiny grain, a small fine particle of a substance.

clue.text: Begin cladding front of ugly house

indicators.note: cladding means the start word wraps around the letter

parts.note: to begin is to start

indicators.note: front of means the first letter of ugly

explanation.surface: Starting to put cladding on the front of an ugly house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house' looks like a building, but it is a royal dynasty: the Stuarts ruled England and Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The Stuarts were a royal dynasty, and a dynasty is called a royal house.

clue.text: Bird's to head-butt door

parts.note: to nut someone is British slang for head-butting them
a hatch is a small door

explanation.surface: A bird about to head-butt a door.
explanation.walkthrough: To nut someone is British slang for head-butting them.
explanation.definitionFit: The nuthatch is a small woodland songbird that climbs tree trunks.

clue.text: Thwart outlaw sailors reported

parts.note: to outlaw something is to ban it

indicators.note: reported means the sailors word is given by its sound

parts.note: jacks are sailors, as in jack tars

explanation.surface: Thwarting an outlaw, as the sailors told it.
explanation.definitionFit: Banjax is Irish and British slang for ruin or spoil, so to wreck someone's plans or frustrate them.

clue.text: Rules indoors most regularly ignored

indicators.note: regularly ignored means every other letter is skipped, keeping the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: House rules that are mostly flouted on a regular basis.
explanation.definitionFit: Norms are standards or customs of behaviour, which act as unwritten rules.

clue.text: Neglected sheep attached to tether

indicators.note: attached to means the sheep sits joined in front of the tether word

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep
to shackle is to chain or tether

explanation.surface: A neglected sheep tied up on a tether.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramshackle describes buildings in disrepair through neglect, falling apart.

clue.text: Apart from head, fish is thrashing

indicators.note: Apart from head means the first letter of the fish is removed

parts.note: a trout is a fish

explanation.surface: A headless fish still thrashing about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrashing' looks like a verb for the fish's writhing, but it is a noun, a heavy defeat.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrashing is a crushing defeat, and so is a rout.

clue.text: Large sin avoiding new tax

indicators.note: avoiding means the new letter is left out of the sin

parts.note: envy is one of the seven deadly sins

explanation.surface: A tax on great wickedness that spares the new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'avoiding' takes N out of ENVY, leaving EVY.
explanation.definitionFit: A levy is a charge or duty imposed by authority, a synonym for a tax.

clue.text: Authoritarian marks a test wrong

indicators.note: wrong means the letters of the marking phrase are put in a mistaken order

explanation.surface: A strict teacher marks an exam incorrectly.
explanation.definitionFit: A taskmaster is a demanding overseer who imposes heavy work, an authoritarian figure.
